capability: Store data sent from the merchant's own site to the platform company: usage tracking and data synced for its services (WooCommerce usage tracking, wc-telemetry; Jetpack Sync)
note: Added by A-woocommerce, batch 2, for WC-C-035 and WC-C-117. WooCommerce only so far: the software runs on the merchant's own site, and these are the flows of the store's data from it to Automattic. Usage tracking has a place of its own: the settings section Advanced > WooCommerce.com (WC-S-0027), its opt-in setting woocommerce_allow_tracking, off by default (WC-S-5370), and the REST namespace wc-telemetry (WC-S-0079); Jetpack Sync, Automattic's, caches the site's data, orders included, to WordPress.com servers as part of the required connection (WC-S-0953, WC-S-0955). Not CM-TRU-008: Shopify Network Intelligence is the platform's use of the store's customer data across merchants, while usage tracking sends the store's own settings and aggregate counts to improve WooCommerce (WC-S-0500, WC-S-0572), a reading. Not CM-ACC-010, the connection itself, nor domain G's CM-OPS-005 (Remote Logging, WC-C-036) or domain D's CM-ANL-001 (WooCommerce Analytics syncing, WC-C-039), which name other flows. `caps` on telemetry, usage tracking, sync, tracker found none.
